meta.title: Task panel
meta.description: Click the checklist icon in the conversation header to see recent session inputs (attachments and @ references), the skills and connectors used in this session, requests that need your attention, and recent files explicitly delivered in this session. Expand rows to see image previews, skill descriptions, and connector tools. Manage live connections for DSH-managed connectors. Open images, skill documents, delivered files, and referenced files in the native right sidebar.
